methodology.notes: Base agent is tau2's shipped ReAct example (examples/agents/react_agent.py) driven by gpt-4.1 (Azure), a two-phase THINK->ACT loop. A learned set of ALTK-Evolve natural-language guidelines is appended to the agent's system prompt (present in both the THINK and ACT phases) after tau2's domain policy. The guidelines were extracted and consolidated by gpt-4.1 using the ALTK-Evolve library (https://github.com/AgentToolkit/altk-evolve) from the retail TRAIN split. User simulator: gpt-5.5 (Azure).

verification.details: Agent system prompt modified: a learned set of ALTK-Evolve natural-language guidelines is appended after tau2's domain policy in both the THINK and ACT phases. Guidelines were learned from the retail train split via gpt-4.1; the base eval split includes those train tasks. No tasks omitted; all 114 base-split tasks run with 4 trials.
